arxiv-2203-13212.title: The partial uniform ellipticity and prescribed problems on the conformal classes of complete metrics
arxiv-2203-13212.creator: Rirong Yuan
arxiv-2203-13212.description: Abstract . We clarify how close a second order fully nonlinear equation can come to uniform ellipticity, through counting large eigenvalues of the linearized operator. This suggests an effective and novel way to understand the structure of fully nonlinear equations of elliptic and parabolic type.

arxiv-2308-13337.title: Evidence of the Coulomb gap in the density of states of MoS 2
arxiv-2308-13337.creator: Michele Masseroni, Tingyu Qu, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Thomas Ihn, Klaus Ensslin
arxiv-2308-13337.description: Abstract MoS 2 \mathrm{MoS_{2}} is an emergent van der Waals material that shows promising prospects in semiconductor industry and optoelectronic applications. However, its electronic properties are not yet fully understood. In particular, the nature of the insulating state at low carrier density deserves further investigation, as it is important for fundamental research and applications.

arxiv-2310-10595.title: Rigidity phenomena and the statistical properties of group actions on CAT ​ ( 0 ) \text{CAT}(0) cube complexes
arxiv-2310-10595.creator: Stephen Cantrell and Eduardo Reyes
arxiv-2310-10595.description: Abstract . We compare the marked length spectra of some pairs of proper and cocompact cubical actions of a non-virtually cyclic group on CAT ⁡ ( 0 ) {\rm CAT}(0) cube complexes. The cubulations are required to be virtually co-special, have the same sets of convex-cocompact subgroups, and admit a contracting element.

arxiv-2505-06633.title: Attention Is Not All You Need: The Importance of Feedforward Networks in Transformer Models
arxiv-2505-06633.creator: Isaac Gerber
arxiv-2505-06633.description: Abstract Decoder-only transformer networks have become incredibly popular for language modeling tasks. State-of-the-art models can have over a hundred transformer blocks, containing billions of trainable parameters, and are trained on trillions of tokens of text. Each transformer block typically consists of a multi-head attention (MHA) mechanism and a two-layer fully connected feedforward network (FFN).

arxiv-2505-20080.title: A note on helicity conservation for compressible Euler equations in a bounded domain with vacuum
arxiv-2505-20080.creator: Yulin Ye
arxiv-2505-20080.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yulin Ye. In this paper, we consider the helicity conservation of weak solutions for the compressible Euler equations in a bounded domain with general pressure law and vacuum. We deduce a sufficient condition for a weak solution conserving the helicity based on the interior Besov-VMO type regularity, the continuous conditions for velocity and vorticity near the boundary, and some regularities for density near vacuum.

arxiv-2506-07800.title: In-situ tuning of cavity dissipation and a topological transition in an atom-nanotip-cavity system
arxiv-2506-07800.creator: Taegyu Ha, Kiyanoush Goudarzi †,, Dowon Lee, Donggeon Kim, Eunchul Jeong, Uijin Kim, Myunghun Kim, Jinuk Kim, Moonjoo Lee
arxiv-2506-07800.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate a method for tuning a dissipation rate in an atom-cavity system. By inserting a nanotip into the cavity mode, we estimate that the cavity dissipation rate increases by a factor of approximately 20 20 , due to the scattering loss at the tip.

pmc-10485908.creator: Zhang Ruijie, Jin Haibo, Ma Lei, Yang Suohe
pmc-10485908.description: 1,4-Cyclohexanedimethanol (CHDM) is a premium polyester monomer. In this paper, a series of Ru– Sn/γ-Al2O3 and Pd/γ-Al2O3 bimetallic composite catalysts were prepared by the impregnation method. The effects of preparation conditions such as active components, preparation methods, and the ratio of Sn to Ru on the reaction activity of the catalysts were studied.

pmc-10633529.title: Laser induced spherical bubble dynamics in partially confined geometry with acoustic feedback from container walls
pmc-10633529.creator: Lei Fu, Xiao-Xuan Liang, Sijia Wang, Siqi Wang, Ping Wang, Zhenxi Zhang, Jing Wang, Alfred Vogel, Cuiping Yao
pmc-10633529.description: Graphical abstract Introduction Cavitation bubble dynamics is strongly influenced by the interaction between the bubble and its environment, and this interaction is usually mediated by changes of the pressure–time-history and of the flow-velocity distribution. A ‘pure’ constellation is the oscillation of a laser-induced spherical bubble in an infinite bulk of liquid.

pmc-11430642.title: The Recent Progress of Tricyclic Aromadendrene-Type Sesquiterpenoids: Biological Activities and Biosynthesis
pmc-11430642.creator: Xiaoguang Yan, Jiaqi Lin, Ziming Liu, Sichone Daniel David, Dongmei Liang, Shengxin Nie, Mingyue Ge, Zhaohui Xue, Weiguo Li, Jianjun Qiao, Miguel Luiz Batista
pmc-11430642.description: The tricyclic-aromadendrene-type sesquiterpenes are widely distributed and exhibit a range of biological activities, including anti-inflammatory, analgesic, antioxidant, antibacterial, insecticidal and cytotoxic properties. Several key sesquiterpene synthases (STSs) of this type have been identified, of which, viridiflorol synthase has been engineered for efficiently biosynthesizing viridiflorol in an Escherichia coli strain.

pmc-11622672.title: The effect of omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fatty Acid (PUFA) prescription preparations on the prevention of clinical cardiovascular disease: a meta-analysis of RCTs
pmc-11622672.creator: Shujie Dong, Yalan Wang, Jialu Bian, Hongsheng Chen, Jie Dong, Jun Zhu, Tongyan Zhang, Qian Du, Rongsheng Zhao
pmc-11622672.description: ImportanceEvidence from systematic reviews of the cardioprotective effect of omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) remains controversial, and interventions including PUFAs dietary supplements or prescription medications cannot accurately reflect the role of PUFA RX in cardiovascular disease (CVD) prevention.ObjectiveWe conducted a meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials (RCTs) to evaluate the efficacy of PUFA prescription medication in preventing CVD.

pmc-12381532.title: Effects of Different Drying Techniques on the Post‐Harvest Quality of Fermented Cocoa Beans in Ghana
pmc-12381532.creator: Lukeman Haruna, Ernest E. Abano, Ernest Teye, Mary Lukeman, Isaac Tukwarlba, Wilson Yeboah, David Nukafo, Kesse J. Agyei
pmc-12381532.description: Drying plays a pivotal role in post‐harvest processing, influencing the quality, storability, and commercial value of cocoa beans. This study compared the impact of three drying techniques—open sun drying (OSD), convective oven drying (COD), and a modified convective oven drying method (MCOD), which emulates sun drying by controlling temperature and humidity—on the quality characteristics of fermented cocoa beans from Ghana.

pmc-13087219.title: Secure quantum-resilient smart city communication networks using QSC-Net with MF-MBO-based energy-aware task scheduling
pmc-13087219.creator: Nalavala Ramanjaneya Reddy, G Arul Dalton, K Swathi, Dasaka V S S Subrahmanyam, Lakshmi Kranthi G, Gujjeti Nagaraju
pmc-13087219.description: Adaptable optimisation that preserves efficiency under time-varying system dynamics necessitates modern task management in innovative city development and in distributed edge–cloud computing systems. Conservative optimisation techniques such as genetic algorithms, particle swarm optimisation, and classical monarch butterfly optimisation (MBO) suffer from premature convergence, poor multi-objective performance, and limited adaptability to changing environments.

pmc-13358306.title: Low-dose corticosteroids in severe pulmonary infection: a meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
pmc-13358306.creator: Joanne Lac, Sooyeon Han, Mahmood Ahmad, Harvey Starey, Soham Ganguly, Michael Tett, Oluwatosin Adeyemi, Jonathan J H Bray, Malik T Ahmad, Rui Providência
pmc-13358306.description: PurposePulmonary infections are one of the leading causes of intensive care unit (ICU) admission and contribute to high mortality rates. This paper aimed to determine the effect of low-dose corticosteroids on outcomes in patients with severe pulmonary infections, including coronavirus disease of 2019, community-acquired pneumonia (CAP), pneumocystis pneumonia, sepsis, septic shock, and acute respiratory distress syndrome.

pmc-13485161.title: Vertical Growth of Facial Soft Tissues: A Longitudinal Three‐Dimensional Facial Growth Study
pmc-13485161.creator: Signe Silinevica, Amir Nassereldine, Gundega Jakobsone, Jinjun Xiong
pmc-13485161.description: ObjectiveThis longitudinal cohort study aimed to assess changes in vertical facial landmarks in individuals aged 10 to 18 years and identify sex differences in growth patterns.Materials and MethodsOne hundred and one individuals (males, n = 56; females, n = 45) were observed. Three‐dimensional facial surface images were acquired using stereophotogrammetry every 6 months.

uslaw-usc-t42-s3617.title: 42 U.S.C. § 3617 — Interference, coercion, or intimidation
uslaw-usc-t42-s3617.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s3617.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 45 (Fair Housing); Subchapter I (Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It shall be unlawful to coerce, intimidate, threaten, or interfere with any person in the exercise or enjoyment of, or on account of his having exercised or enjoyed, or on account of his having aided or encouraged any other person.
